threads.label: The treasure map.
threads.text: You followed it to Brandonsford, arriving at sunset, though the places it shows are unfamiliar to you. The treasure is still to be found.

threads.label: The Clurichen of the riverbanks.
threads.text: Reginald warned you that this trickster comes into town from the riverbanks every night. What it does here is still unknown.

threads.label: The black dragon.
threads.text: Eric the Reeve offers one thousand gold for its body, dragged into town. It tore off George the woodsman's arm, and Farmer Gill's three sons are hunting it now.

threads.label: Lady Hilda's offer.
threads.text: She will join your fight against the dragon if you pay her.

threads.label: Drop Dead Ned.
threads.text: He offered to work for Dr. Uriah, along with his killer wasp, for one hundred gold a week.

threads.label: The missing shipments.
threads.text: Bentley and Farmer Gill told you the town's tavern and smithy are running short. Why nothing has reached Brandonsford in months remains unknown.

threads.label: Sir Phidipaldi's duel.
threads.text: He challenged Eric the Reeve to fight at dawn, but Eric has not accepted.

threads.label: Quinn's vanishing ale.
threads.text: Quinn, owner of the Golden Egg, blames Bentley for stealing it and offers one hundred gold for revenge. Who or what empties his stock each night is still unknown.

threads.label: Farmer Gill's tale.
threads.text: Over drinks, he told Dunk how Sir Brandon slew a dragon long ago.

closing: Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn are at the Golden Egg, about to fill bottles with water and stage a showy fake ale delivery. Wayman Tisdale and Dr. Uriah are across the street at the Clumsy Fox. Dunk is at Farmer Gill's farm, planning to sleep in the barn.
